raw_comment:
What do you notice?
I notice that most of the exceptional drought occurs near the middle parts of the United States. The abnormally dry areas were mostly near the eastern and western coasts. 

What do you wonder?
I wonder if the droughts will stay the same or change. Why did specific places face more severe droughts? Does it have to do with climate change? Why are they having problems if they are right by tons of water?

How does this relate to you and your community?
This relates to me and my community because we can be updated about impacts of it with things such as fires in dry areas. It also affects our environment. 

Create a catchy headline that captures the graph’s main idea.
From Coast to Coast: Examining the Intensity of Droughts in the U.S.
